description: Sends the eng workflow contract and the core writing rules at session start and after each compaction, and adds a few categorical guards: no comment, review or reply is posted; every remote write the hook finds from a subagent is denied: a shell command's, a post through any MCP tool, an MCP write whose name asks, and the GitHub and git MCP writes it maps to commits, pushes, PRs and issues; merges, releases, deploys, force pushes and other writes that are hard to take back ask first, while commits, pushes, PRs and issues are left to Claude Code's own permissions; code-review never runs with --comment or --post, and the model never runs it with --fix or ultra; and changed code that has not been reviewed gets one reminder before hand-back.
